profile.headline: Experienced software engineer
profile.summary:
Experienced software engineer and architect. I am most familiar with Clojure/ClojureScript, Java and the JVM, TypeScript, browser APIs, Node.js, and rules engines. I am an original core contributor of the Clara Rules engine open source project @ https://github.com/cerner/clara-rules

I enjoy reading technical blogs/papers/articles, open source project source code, listening to technical talks, and I am fan of theoretical computer science and math topics. I am experienced in the paradigms of functional programming and object oriented programming. I am typically more drawn to functional programming over the latter, but there can be a blend of both that works.

I am also an enthusiast of kinetics, physics, genomics and biological topics primarily around immunology and metabolism.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
At Cerner, I have been a software engineer working with the Clojure language as my primary development language for nearly four years.  I consider myself to be proficient and comfortable with Clojure, including the lower-level mechanics of the language.  Along with Clojure, I still interact with the Java language and the Java ecosystem regularly.  

I work within the big data processing space using technologies such as Apache Crunch, Hadoop, Avro, Hive, etc.  Along with big data processing, I have had a lot of experience working with, and researching, Rete-inspired rules engines, such as JBoss Drools, Jess, and the newer Clara rules engine.
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Requirements · Coding Standards · User Requirements · Emacs · Docker Products · Debugging · Rules Engines

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed enterprise-scale, genomics research software
solutions providing scientists with the functionality to save, retrieve, view, and analyze
large amounts of data

• Gained experience developing J2EE applications integrating technologies such as Spring
framework, Hibernate, Maven, SVN, Oracle SQL, Hadoop, Apache and WebLogic

• Collaborated in a team-based environment with focus on agile software design

• Designed and implemented software solutions for large, data-centric applications in the
complex domain of genomics research

• Utilized agile methodologies, such as test-driven development, continuous integration,
daily scrums, code reviews, user story based requirements, and iterative release cycles

• Experienced in the process of developing software features from the gathering
functional requirements through to deployment into the production environment
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Requirements · Coding Standards · User Requirements · Emacs · Debugging

positions.title: Computer Science Tutor
positions.description:
Provided one on one tutoring with a focus on teaching
object-oriented design principles with Java

• Improved own understanding and knowledge of the Java language and object-oriented
design

• Met regularly to discuss class progress and review recent class notes, exams, and
programming assignments to determine which problem areas to focus on

positions.title: Bioinformatics Student Researcher
positions.description:
Researched, designed, and implemented an
algorithmic, automated approach for annotating genes to assist scientific research efforts,
while assisting in maintenance of a data-driven, Rails web application

• Developed prediction-based method of automating the annotation of genes with Gene
Ontology terms by applying machine learning and text mining techniques on existing
gene annotations in a genomics research database

• Presented overviews of research results to an interdisciplinary team in order to
stimulate collaboration, understanding, and feedback from all members of the team

• Gained valuable experience working in a team environment consisting of a both
computer science students, biology students and college professors

projects.title: Clara Rules Engine
projects.description:
One of the original core contributors to the Clara Rules forward chaining rete-based rules engine, written in Clojure and ClojureScript.

https://github.com/cerner/clara-rules
